records.title: Local-first answer pipeline
records.text: another_brain uses a local-first answer path: user input becomes a state packet, static local retrieval builds an evidence packet, the browser q4 decoder may draft, then hard router, verifier, finalizer, and fallback decide the final answer.

records.title: Static q4 experimental runtime
records.text: The browser runtime is static-only and can use same-origin R28M1 q4 shards with the exact runtime tokenizer. It is an engineering preview, not product admission, browser admission, or a release checkpoint.

records.title: Hard router boundary surfaces
records.text: The hard router is a product-surface guard. It handles insufficient evidence, conflicting evidence, malicious evidence, unstable model output, non-product status, and identity boundary. It is not a broad answer bank.

records.title: Lightweight static RAG
records.text: R28RAG2 uses a small static memory index and source registry in the browser. Retrieval uses keyword overlap, Chinese character ngrams, BM25-like rarity weighting, title/source boosts, and evidence status classification.
